PES Services - Prolific Heating International # PES Services ## Prolific Engineering & Services Co., Ltd (PES) History On December 12, 2012 , Prolific Group expanded into 2 companies, with Prolific Engineering & Service Co., Ltd. (PES) becoming the addition to Prolific Heating International Co., Ltd. (PHI) in order to fully serve ever – increasing customers. PHI focuses on the design, manufacture, trading, and servicing of heaters and heating – related equipment, while PES focuses on the design & manufacture, repair, and servicing of furnaces and other related services. As a result, Prolific Group has comprehensive products and services for the extensive heating and furnace industries. ### Prolific Engineering and Services (PES)“Heart of Furnace” Line of Business : - Repair & Preventive Maintenance (Overhaul, Installation, & etc) - Manufacturing (In-house or other furnace) - After services (IPSEN & Nabertherm) - Retrofit (Prothermal Business Solution) - Other services For more information, do not hesitate to contact us here or contact our LINE & WhatsApp ##
